title: Vector Stores in .NET
description: Persist and query embeddings in C# backends using Azure AI Search, PostgreSQL pgvector, and other vector-capable stores.

blocks.text: A vector store in a .NET backend is usually a regular database with an extra vector similarity capability. This lets you filter by business metadata, sort by meaning, and return cited chunks in one query.

blocks.title: Interface sketch for a vector store
blocks.content: A minimal abstraction that hides the underlying store.

blocks.title: Use one store at first
blocks.text: pgvector is excellent for learning and small-to-medium production workloads. Add a second store only when you need specialized capabilities such as managed scale or hybrid search.

blocks.title: Persist and Query Embeddings
blocks.description: Store embeddings in a local PostgreSQL database with pgvector and run similarity search.
steps: Install PostgreSQL and enable the pgvector extension.
Create a table with a vector column and metadata columns.
Insert embedding records from your previous chunking exercise.
Query with a text embedding and metadata filter.
blocks.expectedOutcome: You should see ranked results with similarity scores and the ability to filter by document metadata.
